biz.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
biz.summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.

biz.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
biz.summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

biz.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
biz.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

biz.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
biz.summary: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.

biz.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
biz.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

biz.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
biz.summary: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

biz.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers’ details were stolen in data breach
biz.summary: Todoist said a hacker gained access to its production systems and stole customer data, including email IDs, password hashes, and account creation dates.

biz.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
biz.summary: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

biz.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down next week amid IPO uncertainty
biz.summary: Flipkart's product and technology chief Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the company alongside its board until a successor is found.
